name: Well Hall Pleasaunce Playground
description: Well Hall Pleasaunce is one of Greenwich's Green Flag Award-winning sites and it has achieved a silver gilt in the small park of the year category of the London in Bloom awards. It also has a bowling green, play area and several water features.
